description: This header defines the TestExecutor class, which implements an ExecutorInterface for scheduling and executing tasks, and manages an internal EventQueue for scheduling operations.

classes.name: TestExecutor
classes.description: A test implementation of ExecutorInterface that manages scheduling tasks with an internal EventQueue.

methods.name: scheduleByTimestamp
methods.description: Schedules a task to run at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: scheduleForLater
methods.description: Schedules a task to run after a specified delay.

methods.name: executeAll
methods.description: Executes all scheduled tasks up to the current time.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of scheduled tasks.

methods.name: getForUnitTest
methods.description: Retrieves a scheduled task by index, primarily for unit testing.
